core_record_coverage.rule: Each positive specimen is pinned before codec implementation; structural success is not native success.

fault_injection_policy.scope: Controlled synthetic fixtures only after build go; no real APIs, sealed stores or scientific-native campaign.
fault_injection_policy.method: Deterministic named barriers; kill coordinator sibling while independent service/oracle survives. Fresh process reads original stable IDs. Windows helpers hidden; bounded waits and explicit owned cleanup.
fault_injection_policy.truth_source: Independent provider/owner state and artifact bytes, never only driver-returned labels. Evaluator-only oracle data is not in coordinator/native request inputs.
fault_injection_policy.no_skip: Mandatory new cases execute without skips. Environment/process-control failures are failures to diagnose, not grounds to weaken assertions.

scope_limits: These are frozen proposed expectations, not test execution receipts.
Actual native integrations, hostile isolation, real money/sealed usage, multi-host stores and power-loss qualification need named authorized mechanisms/evidence.
Four retrospective archives cannot be promoted into positive runnable experiments; new fixture experiments get new identities and complete supplied bindings.
